text:
ivy (Product): quick design feedback on the Create API Key modal — when an org has many roles the multiselect becomes noisy and users lose the "applies to key" context.

drew (PM): saw a support ticket where someone thought roles were assigned to their user. can we add a one-line clarifier: 'These roles will be granted to this API key.' near the picker?

nate (Frontend): i can repro an accessibility issue: arrow keys navigate into the virtual list and then focus gets trapped. also the removable chips have no explicit remove control for keyboard users.

kai (A11y): confirmed; screen readers read chips as plain text. need an aria-live region that says "X roles selected" on change, and remove buttons should be labelled e.g. "Remove role billing.read".

ivy (Product): my quick UX idea: show up to 4 pills inline then a "+N more" button that opens a compact dialog with full list + checkboxes. keeps modal tidy and preserves context.

drew (PM): +1. also for wildcard or admin.* scopes we should surface a stronger inline banner (icon + orange tint) that says why it's risky. keep it one line with an expand for details.

nate (Frontend): implementation notes: condensed pills are CSS; "+N more" is a real button that opens a dialog with role=dialog and focus trap. i'll change key handling so the list container manages arrow keys and tabbing out works. will add `data-telemetry="overflow_open"`.

kai (A11y): prefer a custom disclosure for the banner so we can set `aria-expanded` and announce content. ensure the dialog receives initial focus and that the close button is labelled. check contrast for banner text at small sizes.

ivy (Product): proposed short banner copy: "Warning: This key grants wide access (admin.*). Use only for trusted services."

nate (Frontend): can implement that. i'll also expose `aria-pressed` for the Show/Hide secret toggle and make its accessible name explicit.

kai (A11y): QA checklist before merge:
- aria-live announces role count changes
- remove buttons labelled and tabbable
- dialog opens with focus and announces title
- banner contrast meets AA or text weight increased
- no keyboard traps in the multiselect

ivy (Product): action items:
1) nate: fix keyboard handling + dialog + telemetry — PR by Wed
2) kai: draft a11y copy & checklist — review Tue
3) drew: telemetry spec + small wording for banner help — add to spec
4) ivy: update empty state copy: "You don't have any API keys yet — create one to get started" and mock the condensed pills

ci-bot: running a11y checks on branch "fix/keys-compact-overflow" — will report failures inline.
